# Combat & Skill Rules Requirements Quality Checklist: Real-Time Action Combat & 60-Skill Engine

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, độ rõ ràng, tính nhất quán và độ phủ yêu cầu cho hệ thống chiến đấu thời gian thực, công thức sát thương, cộng hưởng 9 nguyên tố và động cơ 60 kỹ năng (`004-combat-skills`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Combat Mechanics & Timing Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all timing parameters for Dodge (`300 ms` i-frame, `20` Stamina, `1,200 ms` CDR-immune cooldown, `112 px` distance), Block (`60%` mitigation, `12` Stamina, `1.0s` Guard Break), and Perfect Parry (`200 ms` window, `100%` mitigation, `+15` Stamina, `25%` Poise counter) unambiguously quantified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the complete skill lifecycle (`castTimeMs → startupMs → activeMs → recoveryMs`), including the `40%` late-recovery Dodge/Block cancel window and `150 ms` input buffer, explicitly specified without ambiguity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all 6 server-validated hitbox geometries (`ARC`, `CIRCLE`, `LINE`, `RECT`, `PROJECTILE` with anti-tunneling swept collision, `SELF`) and multi-target/multi-hit cap behaviors defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## Balance Caps, Elemental Synergy & Crowd Control Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Are all hard balance caps (`CritRate <= 75%`, `CritDamage <= 250%`, `CDR <= 40%`, `AttackSpeedMult <= 1.60x`, `DefPenPct <= 50%`, `ElementalRes ∈ [-35%, +70%]`, `MaxStamina <= 260`) consistently stated with `docs/balancing/combat-formulas.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the 9-element affinity multipliers (`1.25x / 1.20x / 0.85x / 1.00x`), the 9 elemental reactions, the `2,000 ms` per-pair/per-target ICD, and the `1.35x` reaction multiplier cap unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are CC Diminishing Returns steps (`100% → 50% → 25% → Immune` in a rolling `20s` window) and Boss Hard-CC conversion into Poise/Frostbite completely defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Visual Readability & Combat Feel Requirements

- [ ] CHK007 Are the Ultimate readability constraints (player ground VFX strictly below Boss telegraphs with `alpha <= 0.45`, fullscreen flash `<= 3 Hz`, toggleable `Camera Shake 0%–100%`, client-only hit-stop never stalling server ticks) explicitly testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK008 Are Boss Phase HP Floor Guard and maximum `3` Stagger breaks per phase clearly stated to prevent phase-skipping exploits? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Security, Anti-Cheat & Persistence Alignment

- [ ] CHK009 Do requirements strictly prohibit trusting client-supplied damage, hit confirmation, critical flags, i-frame states, or cooldown overrides? [Security, Spec §FR-001, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the `5-second` Combat Logout Grace window consistent with `anti-cheat-design.md` (`SEC-013`) and clearly bounded against permanent gear loss on death? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are runtime combat states cleanly separated from local JSON disk writes (RAM at `20 Hz`, dirty checkpoint flush every `30s` / zone exit / disconnect, zero per-tick disk I/O)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Constitution §I, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK012 Are unverified server tick and client frame-rate goals explicitly marked `proposed / unverified` without implying completed load benchmarks? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004, Constitution §VIII]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
